facts_carried_over: University of Tennessee at Chattanooga reported Fall 2025 enrollment of 12,060 and 73.3% one-year retention. Source: UTC official news, 2025-09-08.
UTC launched implementation of its Strategic Enrollment Plan, including separate retention and technology-optimization workgroups. Source: UTC official news, 2026-01-13.
UTC publicly identifies Navigate as its student-success platform. Source: UTC official Navigate page, accessed 2026-09-03.
LSU Shreveport reported Fall 2025 enrollment of 11,359. Source: LSUS official news, 2025-11-12.
LSUS reported redesigned student-support systems and improved second- and third-year persistence. Source: LSUS official news, 2026-04-09.
UA Little Rock reported Fall 2025 enrollment of 8,026. Source: UA Little Rock official quick facts, accessed 2026-09-03.
UA Little Rock reported strong Fall 2025 continuing-freshman and sophomore growth. Source: UA Little Rock official news, 2025-09-05.
Murray State reported Fall 2025 enrollment of 9,932 and 78% first-to-second-year retention. Source: Murray State official news, 2025-10-29.
Murray State reported Spring 2026 headcount of 9,111 and Fall 2025-to-Spring 2026 freshman persistence of 91%. Source: Murray State President communications, 2026-02-02.
